heroHeadline: North Korea and South Korea Exchange Military Threats Over DMZ Blast
heroSubtitle: North Korea and South Korea exchanged military threats on September 30, 2026 following a blast near the DMZ, raising inter-Korean tensions. The incident marks a significant escalation along the demilitarized zone, coming days after North Korea condemned US approval of South Korea's nuclear submarine program and Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui declared the DPRK's nuclear status 'irreversible.'
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
